study: Interface typography of Chinese mobile apps (zh-Hans / zh-Hant), read-only research from official public pages. No app was installed; no interactive session happened. App-UI observations come from official Apple App Store (CN) screenshots downloaded at full resolution and visually inspected, plus official web pages.
method_note: Factual fields (version, dates, developer, languages) were taken from Apple's official public iTunes Lookup/Search API (itunes.apple.com/lookup, itunes.apple.com/search) and cross-checked against the apps.apple.com/cn listing pages read the same day. Typography observations are visual readings of official screenshots; exact font file names cannot be proven from pixels and are marked as such.

apps.developer: AutoNavi Information Technology Co. Ltd. (store seller string: AUTONAVI INFO TECHNOLOGY CO LTD; Alibaba group entity)
apps.platform: Android / iOS (iOS App Store CN listing inspected)

observations.font_family: All rendered text is heiti (CJK sans). Headlines ('导航Live 下一代出行', '高德扫街榜2026', '高德顺风车') use an extra-heavy, slightly-rounded black heiti that is clearly a brand/marketing cut; body/UI text is a standard-weight heiti consistent with iOS PingFang SC. Exact family name NOT verifiable from pixels; no font name is stated anywhere on the listing. Digits inside heavy headlines match the CJK weight (custom or weight-matched digits).
observations.hierarchy: Clear 5-level ladder visible: (1) very large heavy marketing headline; (2) medium subtitle line; (3) in-app screen title / tab bar (推荐 热门 美食 玩乐 休闲 购物 酒店…) with blue selected state + short underline; (4) list body: POI name dark semibold, meta line grey ('4.9 分 全年热度值98.2 好友评分4.7 累计导航860万公里'); (5) fine print disclaimer in light grey small size at top of every marketing screenshot: '本图片仅为示例，实际商品或活动以实际公示为准'. Selected tab/chip = brand blue text + blue outline chip; unselected = dark grey text.
observations.line_breaking: No spaces anywhere between Han characters; body paragraphs wrap character-by-character. Long strings clamp with single ellipsis '…' ('关于雷峰塔的兴建，有两种说…'). Horizontally scrollable tab/chip rows are simply clipped at the screen edge with no ellipsis (旅游→'旅', '拼座' chip half-visible). No hyphenation, no justification artifacts.
observations.mixed_scripts: Digits and Latin set tight against CJK with no spaces: '2.0公里', '1.1公里', '全年热度值98.2', '¥152/人', '订单里程11.6km', '武昌区 距您 500m', '今天 14:45-15:00', '24h(簋街总店)'. Rating value '4.9' and '4.9 分' render the digits in a rounded numeric style and brand blue, visually distinct from the following CJK unit. Time ranges use half-width hyphen '14:45-15:00'; half-width colon in clock times. District + distance separated by spaces: '武昌区 距您 500m'.
observations.punctuation: Full-width CJK punctuation in sentences: ，、。？ and full-width quotes “十景之一”. Full-width tilde not seen; marketing uses full-width comma between clauses. INCONSISTENCY observed: POI name '胡大饭馆24h(簋街总店)' uses HALF-width parentheses in UI while marketing text uses full-width （）. App Store description uses 丶 (U+4E36 dot character) instead of 、 between travel modes ('驾车丶打车丶公交丶骑行') — a listing-text quirk worth flagging. Filter '区/县' uses half-width slash.
observations.unavailable_states: Privacy placeholders in official screenshots: street addresses blurred out; prices shown as literal placeholder 'X 元' / '拼座 X 元'; promo banner shows '最高日赚 XXX 元' (XXX placeholder). State tags as colored chips: '已支付' green chip, '在线' green-dot chip, muted chip '隐藏乘客不承担高速费' grey. Grey placeholder text in the empty destination input: '你要去哪儿'. Regulatory disclaimer line rendered on every marketing screenshot (see hierarchy).
observations.script_variants: CN App Store listing declares languages: 简体中文、繁体中文、英语 (Simplified + Traditional Chinese + English) — confirmed both by the listing page '语言' row and the iTunes Lookup API (two ZH codes + EN). v17.0.2 release notes claim '一个高德畅游世界 200+国家、78种语言'. Interface text seen in screenshots is simplified zh-Hans only; no zh-Hant screen was available in official material.
observations.audio_labels: n/a for this class; closest equivalents: voice assistant wake word quoted as '你好小德'; 导航Live AI narration shows a place card '雷峰塔 / 4.9 分 文物古迹 / 西湖“十景之一”' plus a narration text bubble clamped with '…', and a voice-input pill '按住说话' (hold to talk). Audio is represented by icon-only speaker buttons.

apps.notes: Full store title: '高德地图-高德打车,导航公交地铁出行'. Size 326.4 MB, category 导航, min iOS 13.0, rating 4.86 (27.5M ratings). Store page URL with readable 信息 section (语言 row quoted verbatim) read 2026-10-06. Screenshots embedded in the CN listing were fetched from the mzstatic CDN at full 1242x2688 resolution and visually read.

apps.developer: App Store seller shows the individual name 东红 李; official site states the company: 广州三毛信息科技有限公司 (Guangzhou Sanmao Information Technology Co., Ltd.), '版权所有', 粤ICP备16047144号. Store description claims Tencent Sogou & New Oriental investment.
apps.platform: Android / iOS (iOS App Store CN listing inspected; official site offers iOS版/Android版 download buttons)

observations.font_family: Heiti sans throughout the UI. Feature headlines ('景博自助导览', 'AI导游', '金牌说') in a very heavy black heiti; body/narration text regular-weight heiti consistent with iOS system face. One decorative exception: the 金牌说 marketing banner headline '來,讓金牌导游为您现场解读' is set in a brush/calligraphy script — and it MIXES traditional forms 來/讓 with simplified 导游/现场. Exact font files unverifiable from pixels.
observations.hierarchy: (1) brand lockup (green logo + 三毛游); (2) heavy feature headline; (3) grey-black subtitle; (4) in-screen title bar '故宫博物院·三毛游官方讲解' as a floating white pill with 纠错 and 分享 buttons; (5) audio entry title in teal; (6) grey meta (duration, counts); (7) search placeholder '请输入讲解点名称' grey. Chip groups: selected chip filled/colored (全部 340 selected with leading dot; 国内 filled green; 广州 green with pin icon), unselected plain outline.
observations.line_breaking: Narration entry labels are whole narrative phrases, not place names, and are aggressively truncated: map pins show '一场特殊的帝…', '广场上的地砖最后一...' (NOTE: this screenshot mixes the single-glyph ellipsis '…' with three half-width dots '...'), '太和殿广场（…', '紫禁城最大的…', '明朝最幸运的…', '宫中有敌情怎…'. AI-chat answers wrap character-by-character across 6-7 lines with no spaces and clamp with '…'. Suggestion chips at the bottom are horizontally clipped on both edges ('…门都包含什么呢' / '午门是做什么的' cut).
observations.mixed_scripts: 'AI导游', 'VR导览', '这里是文博讲解版的DeepSeek！' inline Latin; digits flush with CJK: '3.4米4吨多重', '13块琉璃', '人均50'-style counts, '覆盖全球100+国家，15000+景区/博物馆' (half-width + and /), durations as '8:42' and '01:31' with half-width colon; counts with a space before CJK: '全部 340', '必听 197'.
observations.punctuation: AI chat quotes user questions with full-width curly quotes: “紫禁城宫殿檐角上的小动物有什么作用？”, full-width ？ and ！ ('上线！', '听不过瘾？'). Full-width vertical bar ｜ as list separator: '精心挑选｜层层选拔｜系统培训'; but the resume bar uses half-width '|': '继续播放 | 太和门'. Title separator is a middle dot with no spaces: '故宫博物院·三毛游官方讲解' (in one screenshot spaced '故宫博物院 · 三毛游官方讲解' — inconsistent). Half-width parentheses in '太和殿广场（…' opening full-width paren — truncated before the closing one. Marketing banner: '來,讓' uses a HALF-width comma inside otherwise CJK text.
observations.unavailable_states: Dedicated error affordance: '纠错' (report error) button with a red numeric badge next to the title bar on every guide screen. '连续播放' has an off-state grey toggle. Search shows empty-field placeholder. Blurred/covered areas in screenshots (privacy). In-store unavailable-purchase states not observed; IAP exists as '学币' bundles (充值98个学币 ¥98.00 etc.).
observations.script_variants: Interface entirely simplified zh-Hans. The CN App Store listing page shows NO 语言 (languages) row and the iTunes Lookup API returns an empty language list — no evidence found of a Traditional Chinese or English interface setting (negative evidence recorded). The only traditional glyphs seen are decorative (來, 讓) in one marketing banner.
observations.audio_labels: Audio entries are labeled with headphone icons on map pins; entry card = thumbnail + title '太和门' + duration '8:42' + two outline pill buttons: '语音讲解' (teal, headphones icon) and 'VR导览' (orange, VR icon). List rows: red badge '必听' (must-listen) on thumbnail, teal title, clock icon + '01:31', a green equalizer-bars icon marking the playing/loaded state, chevron. Bottom sheet tabs: '全部 340' / '必听 197' with counts; '连续播放' toggle; resume strip '▶ 继续播放 | 太和门'. AI mode adds play/copy/regenerate icon row and a '三毛游正在听 ···' status chip.

apps.notes: Full store title: '三毛游-全球博物馆导览景点讲解AI导游预约金牌说'. Size 317.1 MB, category 工具 (Utilities), min iOS 13.0, rating 4.94 (4050 ratings), first released 2022-12-29. Older sibling listings exist (ids 1173736557 v4.2.0 last updated 2022; 1317208624 三毛游FM last updated 2022) — the id-1658976259 listing is the maintained one. Official site nav: 智慧文旅 / 自助导览 / 金牌说 / AI博物馆 / 高清VR / 讲解员派单系统 / FM/视频 / 课程; footer '广州三毛信息科技有限公司 版权所有'. This is a verified tourism/cultural audio-guide class app.

apps.developer: Tencent — store page: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司, 统一社会信用代码 9144030071526726XG
apps.platform: Android / iOS / web (iOS App Store CN listing inspected; weixin.qq.com read)

observations.font_family: Pure system-font UI: all visible Chinese is a standard heiti consistent with iOS PingFang SC; nav title '微信' medium weight, chat names semibold, previews regular grey. No brand font, no rounded/custom digits anywhere in the two screens — digits are the plain system numeric style. (Family name not stated by any official page; attribution to PingFang SC is iOS platform convention, not pixel-provable.)
observations.hierarchy: Nav bar centered title; search bar with grey placeholder '搜索'; chat rows = avatar + name (dark) + one-line preview (grey) + timestamp (small grey, right); unread = red dot on avatar; muted chats show a bell-with-slash icon in place of/next to the timestamp; bottom tab bar 微信/通讯录/发现/我 with green active state.
observations.line_breaking: Group-chat bubbles wrap character-by-character with no spaces or hyphenation ('周六露营活动有没有要一起组团的呀？位置就在同沙岛，露营设备齐全，人均50' breaks mid-phrase at arbitrary glyphs); message previews are strictly single-line (clamp, no visible ellipsis needed in these screens). No word-wrap exceptions observed around Latin runs.
observations.mixed_scripts: Group title '暴走小分队(54)' — member count in half-width parentheses; '翡翠花园11栋业主群' digits inside the name; preview '1703–朱生: 车主来挪一下车' — room number + en-dash before a nickname, half-width colon after nickname; '[图片]' and '[机智]' square-bracket placeholders; '+1' as a bare Latin message; timestamps '16:24' and relative '昨天 10:32' (CJK relative day + space + digits).
observations.punctuation: Messages use full-width ，？！ and full-width tilde '～' ('我想去，加我一个～'); media/emoji placeholders use half-width brackets [图片] [机智]; nickname separators in previews use half-width ':'; the store description uses full-width quotes “雷达加朋友” and bullet '•'. Mixed widths within one line are the norm and no spacing corrections are applied between scripts.
observations.unavailable_states: Muted conversation = icon-only state (bell with slash), no text label; non-text messages previewed as '[图片]' placeholder; store description advertises '关怀模式: 文字与按钮更大更清晰' (care mode enlarges text/buttons — official accessibility label). Update screen equivalent: store '新功能' notes for 8.0.79 read '本次更新：- 解决了一些已知问题。' (generic boilerplate).
observations.script_variants: Strong zh-Hant support: CN listing languages row reads '简体中文和另外25种' including explicitly 简体中文 AND 繁体中文 (26 languages total per lookup API). weixin.qq.com footer separates products: 'WeChat (繁体)' and 'WeChat (EN)' links alongside the mainland 微信 — the traditional/English variants are distributed as distinct brandings. Regional vocabulary differences (e.g., Taiwan/HK string variants) were NOT verifiable from public pages.
observations.audio_labels: Voice message mode is icon-only (waveform-in-circle button, left of the input field) with no text label; the CN listing includes official screenshots titled 语音输入 and 语音转文字 (voice-to-text). Mini-program/download surfaces were not present in the two available official screenshots; store page shows IAP '微信豆' (7个 ¥1.00 …) including one English-named SKU '21 WeBeans ¥3.00' — mixed-script IAP naming.

apps.notes: Full store title: '微信'. Size 967.2 MB, category 社交, min iOS 15.0, rating 4.15 (8.1M ratings), released 2011-01-21. Used here as the download/access-UI class representative (WeChat is the host of the mini-program store and app-update flow; its App Store 新功能 section is the official update-screen text). Mini-program store screens themselves were NOT available in official material — recorded as a gap.

apps.developer: NetEase (杭州网易云音乐科技有限公司 per NetEase corporate listings; page footer not parsed for exact entity)
apps.platform: web (music.163.com/download) / iOS / Android / Mac / PC / WP

observations.font_family: Not determinable from HTML text; the page is a standard web page, no font-family claims read.
observations.hierarchy: Download portal headline: '下载网易云音乐iPhone、iPad、Mac、Android、WP、PC版客户端' listing platforms; login module embedded in the same page.
observations.mixed_scripts: Platform names inline Latin in CJK sentence ('iPhone、iPad、Mac'); phone-code pattern '+86'; password rule '密码长度为8-20位'; '8-20位' digits half-width.
observations.punctuation: FULL-WIDTH SPACE (U+3000) used to justify two-character button labels — a classic CJK UI convention: '登　录', '注　册', '确　定', '取　消' (4-char labels unspaced). Full-width angle book-title marks 《服务条款》 《隐私政策》 《儿童隐私政策》.
observations.unavailable_states: Explicit, labeled error/expiry states in official text: '二维码已失效 点击刷新' (QR code expired — click to refresh), '扫描成功' / '请在手机上确认登录' (scan states), '账号或密码错误' (account or password error) with buttons 确定/取消, '密码不能包含空格', '由于你在非受信任的设备上登录，需要进行短信验证' (untrusted-device state), deprecation notice '云音乐将不再支持 腾讯微博 登录方式'.
observations.script_variants: zh-Hans only; no Traditional Chinese option seen on the page.

apps.notes: Included as SUPPLEMENTARY evidence for the download/access class: this is the official (login-free readable) download + login UI text of a major Chinese app; the download buttons themselves are QR-code/graphical and their visual typography was not inspected. Version field null because the page shows no version number in HTML text. No login was performed; only the public page was read.

negative_evidence.detail: https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id461703850 (initially guessed Amap id) returned HTTP 404 Not Found on 2026-10-06; the correct CN listing is https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/id461703208 (verified via iTunes Lookup API and the listing page).

negative_evidence.item: Huawei AppGallery web listing unreadable without JS
negative_evidence.detail: https://appgallery.huawei.com/app/C10414141 returned HTTP 200 but only a ~3 KB JavaScript application shell (CSP meta, no listing content) to a plain HTTP GET on 2026-10-06 — no Android-side listing data (version, zh-Hant support) could be verified from AppGallery web.

negative_evidence.item: No Traditional-Chinese evidence for 三毛游
negative_evidence.detail: The CN App Store listing page (id1658976259) displays no 语言 row and the iTunes Lookup API returns languageCodesISO2A = [] for it; official site sanmaoyou.com offers no visible language switch. No evidence of zh-Hant/English interface for this app was found (contrast: Amap and WeChat both declare 繁体中文).

No mobile app could be installed or run; ALL app-UI typography observations derive from official App Store (CN) screenshots (viewed at full 1242x2688 / 1242x2208 resolution), official web pages, and official store text. No WeChat mini-program store screen, no app update screen, and no Android-side (MiSans/HarmonyOS Sans) rendering was available in official material.

negative_evidence.item: Web-search tooling degraded for this session
negative_evidence.detail: Two WebSearch calls (WeChat/Amap App Store queries) failed with 'user concurrency limit exceeded' and the third returned low-quality results; app identification was completed instead via Apple's official public iTunes Search/Lookup API (itunes.apple.com/search, itunes.apple.com/lookup), which succeeded for all three apps.

negative_evidence.item: Font family names not officially documented on any read page
negative_evidence.detail: None of the read official pages (App Store listings, weixin.qq.com, sanmaoyou.com, music.163.com/download) names the font families used in-app (e.g., PingFang SC, MiSans, HarmonyOS Sans, custom brand faces). All font_family entries are therefore visual inferences from screenshots, explicitly not pixel-provable to a specific font file.
